lesson.meaning: Being very careful to avoid risks, problems, or mistakes.
examples: Please be cautious when driving in the rain; the roads can be slippery.
The team decided to be cautious with the new budget and not spend too much too quickly.
During the meeting, it's important to be cautious when discussing sensitive client information.
She gave a cautious response to the proposal, saying she needed more time to review it.
When handling customer data, always be cautious to ensure privacy and security.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of a cat walking carefully on a wall – it's cautious not to fall!
